entities.summary: Donald Grate was an American professional baseball and basketball player. He played both Major League Baseball as a right-handed pitcher for the Philadelphia Phillies and NBA basketball as a small forward/shooting guard for the Sheboygan Redskins. Grate was listed at 6 feet 2 inches (1.88 m) tall and 180 pounds (82 kg).
